svg.aria-label: Hall of fame: Agraris, within the hour; NOUNY, within the hour; Purser, within two hours; predict FWA, same day, before round 1; Agent402, same day; Autonomo, same day; LoomDesk, same day; QHooks, same day; Stoa, same day; x402fi, same day; Priors, published 0 to 3 days after the report; Gloam, the last within hours; AgentCity, within a week, answered one by one; 1Shot, within days; Hookr, fixed in the next release
svg.text: Teams that fixed what we reported and said so in public, the fastest first.

g.text: Public listings could set their own GitHub stars, activity
and dates, and links accepted any URL scheme
Three Lows in a review they asked for: weekend vault
creation, a payroll cap, the hook's per-block limit
Three published: a contract could pose as an account and
pay nothing, an open URL fetch, a keyless gas drain
Two game-logic issues, found before launch
Two payment checks: x402 caps against the signed amount,
and a Stellar fallback that took any transfer
The Borro borrow path signed every transaction in the
answer, outside the agent's spending caps
Four gaps in the SDK's send gate
A key-storage issue in how the quantum key was protected
Two Mediums: dust orders could block new limit orders, and
which Uniswap V4 pools the router uses
Three gateway and facilitator payment issues, published as
Eight reports: StockVault, borrowing, the score, AgentKit,
elizaOS and the Rialto stock route
Eight items; seven now published as advisories: relay,
SDK, payments, proofs of funds, holder vote
Five findings across the placement market, terms, key
Embedded-wallet hardening: warnings a host could replace,
cross-site extension sessions, requester origin checks
Two published: drop timing in first-release time shares,
and the launch wallet cap counted per contract

svg.text: A listing says the team handled a report well. It is not an audit and not a statement that the code is safe.
